settings-backup-pw: A password for the encrypted backup action, not a stored setting; it is read when Export is pressed.
s-recovery-dest-id: An identifier consumed by the recovery destination action, not a persisted setting.
s-recovery-dest-path: A path consumed by the recovery destination action, not a persisted setting.
s-recovery-daily: A schedule argument consumed by the recovery schedule action, not a persisted setting.
s-recovery-interval: A schedule argument consumed by the recovery schedule action, not a persisted setting.
s-recovery-time-zone: A schedule argument consumed by the recovery schedule action, not a persisted setting.
s-recovery-run-id: An operation identifier consumed by the recovery cancel action, not a persisted setting.
